entries.en: The vanaras hold their breath. Hanuman crouches low, ready to spring.
entries.sa: सर्वे वानराः शान्ताः पश्यन्ति। हनुमान् उत्पतितुं सज्जः भवति।
entries.ctx: ch5.leap_start · narration (Kathā) — Sundara 5.1: the launch from Mahendra

entries.en: Dadhimukha, keeper of Sugriva's honey grove, runs to the king: the vanaras have drunk all the honey!
entries.sa: दधिमुखः सुग्रीवस्य मधुवनं रक्षति। सः राजानं प्रति धावति। वानराः सर्वं मधु पीतवन्तः!
entries.ctx: ch5.sita · narration (Kathā) — Sundara 5.62–63: Dadhimukha reports the raid on Madhuvana

entries.en: Sugriva laughs. He knows at once: they have found Sita.
entries.sa: सुग्रीवः हसति। ते सीतां दृष्टवन्तः इति सः जानाति।
entries.ctx: ch5.sita · narration (Kathā) — Sundara 5.64: Sugrīva understands that Sītā has been found

entries.en: In the honey grove, Madhuvana, the vanaras sing, dance and tumble from the trees.
entries.sa: मधुवने वानराः गायन्ति, नृत्यन्ति, वृक्षेभ्यः पतन्ति च।
entries.ctx: ch5.sita · hidden moment, narration (Kathā) — Sundara 5.61: the vānaras revel in Madhuvana

entries.en: Stop! This is the king's own grove!
But Angada has told them to drink, and the dance goes on.
entries.sa: परन्तु अङ्गदः 'पिबत' इति उक्तवान्। अतः वानराः नृत्यन्ति एव।
entries.ctx: ch5.sita · hidden moment, narration (Kathā) — Sundara 5.61: Aṅgada allows the feast

entries.en: I warned him: people who say only pleasant things are easy to find. One who says what is hard but good is rare.
entries.sa: अहं तम् एवम् अवदम्। प्रियं वदन्तः जनाः सुलभाः। अप्रियं हितं च वदन् जनः दुर्लभः।
entries.ctx: ch6.vibhishana_refuge · person.vibhishana, hidden moment (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.16.21cd–22ab, his parting words to Rāvaṇa

entries.en: Long ago, when Ravana planned to carry Sita away, Maricha said almost the same words to him.
entries.sa: पूर्वं मारीचः अपि रावणम् एतानि एव वचनानि अवदत्। तदा रावणः सीतां हर्तुम् ऐच्छत्।
entries.ctx: ch6.vibhishana_refuge · hidden moment, narration (Kathā) — Araṇya 3.37.2: Mārīca's counsel

entries.en: Two counsellors gave Ravana the same advice. He listened to neither.
entries.sa: द्वौ मन्त्रिणौ रावणाय एकम् एव हितं वचनम् अवदताम्। सः कस्य अपि वचनं न श्रुतवान्।
entries.ctx: ch6.vibhishana_refuge · hidden moment, narration (Kathā) — the two counsellors

entries.en: The rakshasas shout at the sleeping giant: "Get up!"
entries.ctx: cutscene-kumbhakarna · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.60: the rākṣasas try to wake Kumbhakarṇa

entries.en: They beat him with clubs. He sleeps on.
entries.sa: ते दण्डैः तं ताडयन्ति। सः तु स्वपिति एव।
entries.ctx: cutscene-kumbhakarna · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.60.53: clubs and śataghnīs
cutscene-kumbhakarna · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.60.55–58: he wakes, yawning

entries.en: You make as much noise as you can too. He sleeps on.
entries.sa: त्वम् अपि उच्चैः शब्दं करोषि। सः तु स्वपिति एव।

entries.en: Then Indrajit strikes from the clouds with Brahma's weapon. Rama, Lakshmana and the army fall senseless.
entries.sa: ततः इन्द्रजित् मेघेषु स्थित्वा ब्रह्मास्त्रं क्षिपति। रामः, लक्ष्मणः, सर्वे वानराः च भूमौ पतन्ति।

entries.en: Old Jambavan, wounded too, sends Hanuman north to the mountain of herbs.
entries.sa: वृद्धः जाम्बवान् अपि पीडितः। सः हनुमन्तम् ओषधीनां पर्वतं प्रेषयति।
entries.ctx: ch6.kumbhakarna · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.74: Jāmbavān sends Hanumān

entries.en: Lakshmana takes up one last arrow and makes a vow.
entries.sa: लक्ष्मणः अन्तिमं बाणं गृह्णाति। सः प्रतिज्ञां करोति।
entries.ctx: ch6.indrajit · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.90.69–72: Lakṣmaṇa's act of truth

entries.en: Bharata places the sandals on Rama's feet and bows to him.
entries.sa: भरतः रामस्य पादयोः पादुके स्थापयति। सः रामं नमस्करोति।
entries.ctx: ch6.ravana · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.127.52–53: Bharata returns the sandals
